hypothesis: Scale-persistent non-coaxial curvature of cond_surf and depth_to_base_surf may identify concealed structural complexity not represented by catalogue proximity.

lane.irregularity: The supplied prompt refers to a single method paragraph below, but contains no assigned method paragraph. No authorized lane is inferred.
lane.scope: Only a conductance-depth Hessian commutator and its strain-supported persistence are implemented; other ideas are proposals only.

mechanism: For separately robust-scaled cond_surf and depth_to_base_surf, form Gaussian scale-normalized Hessians at 300 m and 800 m. Their matrix commutator measures non-coaxial curvature; use its normalized magnitude, both-field curvature strength, cross-scale persistence, and positive dilatation support as new channels in an otherwise fixed 19-band spatially cross-fitted model.
non_fault_mimic: Oblique saline-clay basin-fill and lithologic contacts, interpolation seams, or a shared inversion artifact can mimic non-coaxial curvature; these are not proof of permeability or heat.
novelty_claim_scope: No exact Hessian-commutator operator found by keyword and source-code review in the nine pinned repository snapshots. This does not prove worldwide or unpublished novelty.
input_policy: Use the byte-pinned shared template's nineteen-band cache. No previous prediction pixels, leaderboard inversion, SGMC faults, catalogue distances, sample prediction values, vent labels, or catalogue-derived features enter the model.

holdout.truth: Whole original 8-connected catalogue components withheld globally; original known faults minus hidden truth remain pixel-exactly masked from evaluation. Test quadrants are label-blind and training excludes their 8 km collar.
holdout.single_feature_canary: On each held quadrant, report raw signed AUC and max(AUC,1-AUC) for every individual input channel using all withheld positives and a fixed deterministic sample of up to 50000 other active cells. Any orientation-invariant AUC > 0.90 stops efficacy claims.

bootstrap.method: shared paired physical 20 km cluster percentile

holdout.evaluation_representation: Unplaced continuous probabilities, no post-hoc threshold or dot-budget search. The output is a research surface, NOT an optimized dotted submission.
holdout.efficacy_gate: Candidate paired 95% CI lower bound > 0 versus the refitted same-instrument control; a cross-repository current-best victory is NOT asserted without an identically rerun benchmark.
holdout.confirmation: No confirmation or retuning after the surface duplicate STOP. A positive screen alone would not establish promotion.

registry_gate.positive_support: all finite p > 0; no density exemption
registry_gate.scope: All tracked candidate-like aligned TIFFs in the nine pinned snapshots plus the inherited registry saturation witnesses. Missing/inaccessible entries prevent global uniqueness clearance.
registry_gate.on_stop: Retain normalized, format-validated research surface and evidence; do not place final dots, retune to evade a prior, select a slot, or upload.

score_policy: All new measured metric results are HOLDOUT-DTI with evaluator version, withheld-positive count and CI. Historical values supplied by the user are quarantined as USER-REPORTED, not ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED. No leaderboard projection is presented as a score.
